task: Develop AI system for automated geometry theorem proving
input: Formal statements of olympiad-level geometry problems
output: Machine-verifiable, human-readable proofs for Euclidean geometry theorems
scientific_goal: AI system that autonomously solves complex geometry problems without human demonstrations

methods.symbolic_deduction: Forward-chaining deduction engine using provided rules
methods.construction_parsing: Parse geometric constructions using defs.txt definitions
methods.proof_search: Beam search / BFS through deduction space
methods.neural_guidance: Transformer-based policy for guiding proof search (inspired by GPT-f, AlphaGo)
methods.synthetic_data: Generate training data from symbolic proofs

evaluation_benchmark: IMO AG 30 (30 geometry problems from IMO since 2000)
related_work_methods: AlphaGo: neural networks + tree search (Silver et al.)
AlphaGeometry: neuro-symbolic geometry prover (Trinh et al.)
